limitations: Seven whole owned bodies execute. Parent protocol and allocator protocol cases explicitly control their declared game-child contracts; actual cases execute all reached game algorithms without replacement.

Full original static/private/guarded bytes, ordered CPU stores, meaningful child arguments and allocator EAX, normal-return ABI and matching explicit faults are compared. Void incidental GPRs/flags and fault PC/register state are not certified.
